title: Terrier · small dogs with a job
blurb: Earth dogs and ratters: bred small enough to follow quarry underground, and still convinced they are the largest animal in the garden.

items.d: Small English working terrier, 25–30 cm, bred to bolt foxes and follow a scent underground.
Compact English terrier of 28–38 cm, strong, people-friendly and famously tolerant.
The egg-shaped English breed of the 1830s: muscular, fearless, and a comic at home.
The largest terrier, from the Aire valley: otter hunter, army messenger and police dog.
The diehard Scottish terrier, 25 cm tall with a wiry coat, once used against badgers and foxes.
White Scottish terrier from Argyll, bred for otter and fox and kept for its cheerful temper.
